clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope — Covers dimensions, quality and strength, and methods of sampling and test for burnt clay paving bricks for use in construction of pavements.

clauses.title: General
clauses.text: 2. General — shall be mechanically shaped and not hand moulded. when broken, bricks show a uniformly dense structure free from lime, large voids and marked laminations.  Shall have smooth rectangular faces and sharp corners.

clauses.title: Dimensions
clauses.text: 3. Dimensions 190 mm × 90 mm × 90 mm and 190 mm × 90 mm × 40 mm Note — The bricks shall not be provided with frogs.

clauses.title: Tolerances
clauses.text: 4. Tolerances Dimensions Total Tolerance for 20 Bricks mm mm 190 ± 80 90,40 ± 40

clauses.title: Average compressive strength shall
clauses.text: 5.1 Average compressive strength shall be not less than 40 N/mm2

clauses.title: Average water absorption shall
clauses.text: 5.2 Average water absorption shall be not more than 5 percent

clauses.title: Efforescence shall be ‘nil’.
clauses.text: 5.3 Efforescence shall be 'nil'. Note —  For methods of tests, refer to relevant parts of  IS 3495:1992 Method of test for burnt clay building bricks (third revision). For detailed information, refer to IS 3583:1988 Specification for clay paving bricks (second revision). SUMMARY OF IS 3583 : 1988 BURNT CLAY PAVING BRICKS (Second Revision)
